messages:
Devon: PIR kickoff for INC-2026-042 — external latency spike affecting API v2. Need a facilitator and a 30–45min post-incident review window. Prefer week-of next Mon/Tue. Pre-read will include timeline + SLO graphs + pager log excerpts.
Anika: I can facilitate but only mornings PT (08:30–11:00 PT). happy to run if that fits folks.
Maria: mornings PT works for me as well. I'm on call Fri but free next Mon/Tue.
Sam: I can take action tracking and own the follow-ups. Can we make the session 45m to leave time for RCA?
Lee: I can cover infra timeline and hand over kernel/host notes. timezone: UTC+1, afternoons my side are rough.
Devon: ok noted. Looks like a 08:30–11:00 PT window gives overlap w/ EMEA if we pick 08:30 PT (16:30 UTC) — that's late for Janine but doable for Lee.
Anika: 08:30 PT / 16:30 UTC next Mon is my preference. I'll run facilitation checklist. Can someone post the incident timeline snippets as a Gist?
Sam: will upload logs + SLO screenshots by EOD today. I'll also add a short summary doc in the PIR folder.
incident-bot: [AUTOMATION] PIR template created: https://redwood.atlassian.com/PIR/INC-2026-042 — calendar event pending. Use "Needs pre-read" label if you add anything requiring review.
Maria: quick note — customer support reported 10% elevated error rate for customers on Dedicated tier. Add CS impact to pre-read.
Lee: adding infra mitigation steps to draft. also tagging potential postmortem action: investigate autoscaler edge case.
Anika: agenda draft — 1) quick TL;DR (5m) 2) timeline & mitigations (10m) 3) root cause hypotheses (10m) 4) actions & owners (15m) 5) follow-ups / Qs (5m). I'll circulate 24h pre-read.
Devon: perfect. Can someone confirm the facilitator backup? If Anika can't make it, I can step in.
Sam: noted — I and Devon are backups. I'll create a Doodle in case the 08:30 PT slot doesn't work for any key stakeholder.
Anika: thanks — I'll draft the invite with call link and add the agenda + links. Please add any docs to the PIR page under "attachments". Pre-read deadline: 48h before meeting.
Maria: RSVP: yes. Will bring CS impact numbers.
Lee: RSVP: yes for infra rundown.
Devon: locking facilitator: Anika primary; Devon backup. Sam owns action tracking and will maintain the actions sheet post-meeting. Incident-bot: please flag this thread for follow-up. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: [REMINDER] PIR meeting scheduled tentatively for Mon 08:30 PT. Calendar invite will be sent when Doodle confirms attendee availability. Reminder set for 24h pre-read check.
Anika: thanks — closing out here. If anything urgent pops up, ping me directly.
